meta.provenance: every value is COPIED from an audited artifact named in each row's `source`; nothing is recomputed from raw dumps here
meta.comparability: source_kind='clean_single_harness' rows (TIGER-kv / SID-MLP / NEZHA / GDN / Mamba2) are the ONLY mutually comparable block: one single-harness sweep, one H20, node otherwise IDLE, identical timed region, bs=32 beam=50 warmup=20, 4 reps, full test split, all three datasets on one pod. source_kind='prior_local_run' rows come from earlier sessions and/or different harnesses -- read each row's `caveat` before placing it in a table. PUBLISHED paper speeds are deliberately NOT in this file (doc 4: published and H20-local numbers must not be mixed into one comparison table).

collab_export.numbers_changed: none -- values are copied verbatim from our internal package
collab_export.labels: `method` is the delivery doc's own name for the arm; `arm_id` keeps our internal label so a cell can still be referred to unambiguously. In the run_manifest files there is no `method` arm column at all: the original `method` there names the INFERENCE SCRIPT FAMILY (sidmlp / nezha / gdn / …), so it is passed through as `decode_family`, and the arm identity is carried by `tag` -> `arm_id` / `doc_name` instead.
collab_export.paths: absolute cluster paths reduced to project-relative; checkpoint / sem_ids / teacher_cache / pop_cache fields reduced to basename
collab_export.kept_in_full: command, config, seed, hyper-parameters, commit, teacher-cache identity, sample counts, CIs (doc §5.8)
